title: Working calendars ①: ADR for the platform working calendar (objects, resolution, clock key, pushdown)
body:
③ maintainer-directed task · Source: maintainer ruling on #35340 (Bill, 2026-11-19 05:47Z 「同意 p1」, ruling comment https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/35340#issuecomment-7000950747; sub-cards approved 06:03Z 「同意」「都是 p1」).

## 维护者速读
- **问题：** 平台工作日历的设计已裁决，但还没写成 ADR，后面三张实现卡没有合同可依。
- **要做：** 写一份 ADR，把 #35340 裁决的七条落成合同。
- **不做会怎样：** 对象、公式函数、审批时钟三张卡各自理解，口径不一。
- **你要做的：** 无（ADR 合入按 Tier 规则走）。

## Scope
Write the ADR recording the #35340 ruling, one decision per item:
1. Calendars are org-editable runtime data: `sys_work_calendar` (weekly pattern, `HH:mm` periods, required `timezone` in the `iana_time_zone` domain, `is_default`) and `sys_work_calendar_exception` (dated off/on overrides covering holidays, 调休 make-up workdays, shutdowns). Packages reference by code and may seed rows. Precedent `sys_exchange_rate` (ADR-0144).
2. Resolution: explicit code at the consumer → org default → refuse. No silent wall-clock fallback. Business-unit inheritance deferred (ADR-0049: `sys_business_unit.timezone` has no reader).
3. Holiday data: org-entered + import first; a calendar records a "maintained through" date, and computing past it warns or refuses. CN holiday/调休 data as a marketplace package later, never in core.
4. Consumers: formula functions (`addWorkingDays`, `workingDaysBetween`, `addWorkingHours`) and approval `escalation.clock`, shipping in the same release as the objects (the #13655 constraint: no calendar without its formula surface).
5. Clock key: `escalation.clock: 'wall_clock' | 'working_time'` + optional `calendar` code, default `wall_clock`; only `timeoutHours` gets it.
6. Pushdown: working-day functions evaluate in memory only; pushdown refuses them; filter on due time via a write-time datetime column compared with `{now}`.
7. Periods crossing midnight are refused in the first cut.

Also record the second source of truth found in `ui/packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts:2956-2957` (gantt `skipWeekends` / `holidays`) as a follow-up.

## Done when
ADR merged; it names the three implementation cards (②③④ under #35340) as its enforcement.

## Non-goals
Shift rostering, finite-capacity scheduling, payroll calendars, fiscal periods.

Analysis: `/mnt/project-files/card-35340/design-analysis.md` (project files).
